text: わたしは　ひとり　ぐらし　だから　ポケモン　かってる　わけ！

structure.jp: わたしは　ひとり　ぐらし　だから
ポケモン　かってる　わけ！

patterns.name: 〜わけだ
patterns.explanation: わけ at the end says 'that's the reason, that's how it comes about'; the だ is dropped in casual speech. かってる　わけ = 'that's why I keep them'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what comes next. ひとり　ぐらし　だから = 'because I live alone'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the casual short form of ている, which shows an ongoing state. かってる = 'am keeping (as pets)'.
